_comment: Page level schema type. Anything not listed here is a NewsArticle, which is correct
for a recap, a reaction or a reported piece. Evergreen reference pages are listed
explicitly so _schema_normalize.py stops unifying them back to NewsArticle.
Schema.org types only, and only ones that are a supertype or subtype of Article, so
the rest of the markup on the page stays valid. Add a page here when its job is to
answer a question that will still be asked next year, not to report something.
